name: Esparx Chat Popup
author: Madhabi

sections.description:
Esparx Chat Popup is a lightweight and easy-to-use plugin that allows you to add a Chat chat button to your website. It enables visitors to quickly get in touch with you via Chat in just one click.

Features:
– Simple integration of a Chat chat popup.
– Customizable button text and position.
– Mobile-friendly design.
– No coding required.

Arbitrary section

This plugin does not store any user data or set cookies. It simply links users to Chat with prefilled messages.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/esparx-Chat-popup directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to the plugin settings page to configure your Chat number and preferences.
sections.faq:
Can I use a different phone number for different pages?

Not yet. Currently, the plugin supports a single number across the site.

Is it mobile responsive?

Yes, the Chat popup is optimized for both desktop and mobile.

Can I write custom text message?

Yes, the plugin allows you to choose custom text messages.
